usage: agentware ingest [-h] [--format {text,json}]
                        --source {docs,github-issues} --path PATH
                        [--tags TAGS] [--only ONLY] [--commit]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --source {docs,github-issues}
                        source adapter: docs | github-issues
  --path PATH           LOCAL docs dir or github-issues JSON export (agentware
                        NEVER fetches the network)
  --tags TAGS           extra comma-separated tags applied to every candidate
  --only ONLY           comma-separated topic slugs to commit (the reviewed
                        subset; default: all valid)
  --commit              register the selected candidates with source: imported
                        (default: dry-run, registers nothing)
